sentences.en: But previous stage treatments have appeared intent on presenting his tales merely as more explicit medieval precursors of the Carry On romps.

sentences.en: The Late Night Romps section includes Japanese shocker Battle Royale and a new print of Todd Browning's 1932 classic Freaks.

sentences.en: Heavenly Sword for the PS3 has Nariko, a red-haired beauty who romps around in flowing gowns, slashing bad guys with her special sword.
